verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a first-party Webhooks feature that automatically sends notifications for applicant verification events to a configured endpoint. A rollout-percentage setting lets traffic to that endpoint be ramped up gradually, and webhooks can be tested in Sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Sumsub’s Webhooks is a tool that allows you to automatically receive notifications for various events and changes related to your applicants’ verification process.
With the Rollout percentage setting, you can start with a small share of traffic, such as 10%, check that the endpoint works as expected, then increase the value to 50% and later to 100%.
Set up and test your integration using app tokens, webhooks, and our WebSDK.
